text.text_excerpt: We came here on a Friday night when there was live music. I wanted to sit outside because it was a nice Spring day and the 2 person band was outside. I was glad we didn't sit outside, we sat close to the open doors to the outside because it would been a little too loud to hear each other talk. I felt where we sat was absolutely perfect and the hostess was very accommodating. We waited about 10 minutes before anyone came by to take our drink order and a waitress noticed us sitting there, drink-less. So even though she wasn't our waitress, she took our drink order, I felt that said alot about her. Finally our waiter shows up and wasn't as welcoming as she was but oh well. We ordered the faj...

Our meal was a real treat tonight. We ordered the Pineapple Jalapeno and Pomegranate Margaritas. Both were excellent. We shared the Mesquite Grill for two (it is a trio fajita meal). plenty of food leftover too. THEN, we had the fried ice cream. Staff was courteous and attentive. We look forward to returning.

Harahan needed this!!! Great place to get Mexican food (some a bit Mexican American but I'm OK with that considering the location and it's a chain), and delicious margaritas in a million flavors. The service was great, food was delicious, and atmosphere fun. Can't wait to make it a regular place!!!
